video_title: De’Anthony Melton recaps big night in Warriors’ win vs. Kings | NBC Sports BA

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams' impact on the Warriors' bench rotation
quotes.excerpt: He do so many great things on the court and especially in transition and his speed

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Brandon Williams made his debut tonight, coming back from his injury. How good is it for your bench to have that boost coming in a game?

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: He is my dog right there. He do so many great things on the court and especially in transition and his speed and quickness to get to the rim. I don't think there is too many people really stopping him getting there. It is just about making layups and he made seven of them today, so he is just exceptional.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on Brandon Williams after his return to the Warriors rotation: He is my dog right there. He does so many great things on the court and his speed and quickness to get to the rim is exceptional.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton discusses the impact of Brandon Williams returning from injury during the Warriors' win against the Kings.

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' philosophy on protecting home court after road trips
quotes.excerpt: We got to protect home court no matter what, so I think we are doing a great job

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Two games back-to-back at home, two wins. What has been the philosophy coming back home after a tough road trip?

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: This little skid we had, we felt like we were getting punched in the mouth, so we wanted to come out here and start punching first and get more discipline on both sides of the ball. We got to protect home court no matter what, so I think we are doing a great job of that. Now it is just about continuing this run and keeping it going.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on the Warriors mindset after a tough road trip: We felt like we were getting punched in the mouth so we wanted to come out here and start punching first and get more discipline on both sides of the ball.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton explains the team's mindset regarding protecting home court following a difficult road trip.

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' focus on ball movement and high-quality shot selection
quotes.excerpt: It seems like much better shot, high-quality shots you guys are getting

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: You guys get 37 assists on 49 buckets and 20 made threes as a team. Talk about how many catch-and-shoot threes you guys get up, because that tells me the ball is moving, they are in rhythm, and it seems like much better shot, high-quality shots you guys are getting.

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: We tweaked a couple things that people were kind of scouting on us, so we changed a couple things and also we were just sticking to our game plan and just making sure the ball was moving as long as our bodies. We are trying to keep the defense honest and just keep them in misdirection.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on the Warriors offensive adjustments: We tweaked a couple things that people were scouting on us and we were just sticking to our game plan and making sure the ball was moving as long as our bodies.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton describes the adjustments the Warriors made to their offensive game plan to improve ball movement and shot quality.

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Adjusting to non-Stephen Curry minutes in the rotation
quotes.excerpt: When he is in the game, he is going to do so many great things for us

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: A big conversation has been the non-Stephen Curry minutes. I think personally that is a chance for you guys to work on those non-Stephen Curry minutes. How do you guys view this period right now that you are playing without Stephen in the lineup?

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: Just like you said, non-Stephen minutes, we got to win those minutes because when he is in the game, he is going to do so many great things for us. When he is off the court, we got to just make sure we maintain the lead and sometimes when we are winning, even grow the lead. We are trying to figure it out when he is not on the floor and I think we are coming around that corner with it.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on the Warriors playing without Stephen Curry: When he is off the court we have to make sure we maintain the lead and sometimes even grow the lead. We are trying to figure it out and we are coming around that corner.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton discusses the importance of the team maintaining or extending leads while Stephen Curry is off the floor.

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Depth and next-man-up mentality on the Warriors' roster
quotes.excerpt: I think the beauty of this team, we got so much depth and we got so much confidence

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Tonight the bench had 61 points to Sacramento's 19. Talk about the contribution from your bench tonight.

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: I have been saying this since day one, how much depth we got. I think anybody on this team could really go. The dudes that are not even really playing can still go. I think the beauty of this team, we got so much depth and we got so much confidence that anybody that steps up, it is always next man up for sure.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on the Warriors bench depth: I have been saying this since day one. The beauty of this team is we have so much depth and confidence that anybody that steps up it is always next man up for sure.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton praises the depth of the Warriors' roster after the bench outscored the Kings' reserves.
